method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Cooling Inflation, Surging Bank Earnings Power Stocks
Equities.reason: Captures the dominant market-wide bullish narrative: softer inflation prints combined with strong bank earnings reduce recession/funding risk and lift cyclicals and financials — constructive for broad equities and risk appetite.

Equities.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq end higher on cool inflation data, solid bank earnings
Equities.reason: Representative market-close read confirming that soft inflation and bank results are the immediate drivers of risk-on flows into major U.S. indices — supportive but somewhat near-term.

Equities.title: US Stocks Advance as Traders Digest Softer Inflation Data
Equities.reason: Another cross-market confirmation that cooler inflation is the primary rally catalyst; useful for the prevailing regime view (growth/carry over defensive positioning).

Equities.title: ASML rises 5% after hiking sales forecast for second time this year on strong AI chip demand
Equities.summary: ASML on Wednesday raised its guidance for a second time this year as its customers continue to ramp up their production capacity of AI chips.
Equities.reason: High-relevance leadership signal: ASML guide-up underscores durable AI-driven capex in semiconductors, reinforcing the market’s tech/AI leadership narrative and supporting cyclicals tied to chip supply chains.

Equities.title: Big Banks’ Profits Surge After a Red-Hot Quarter on Wall Street
Equities.reason: Banks reporting strong profits is a broad market positive — boosts financial sector, reduces earnings uncertainty and supports overall index performance during earnings season.

Equities.title: China posts slowest quarterly growth since 2022 as investment slumps, fanning stimulus calls
Equities.summary: That second-quarter growth came below Beijing's full-year growth target range of 4.5% to 5%, the least ambitious goal in decades.
Equities.reason: Material macro headwind: weaker Chinese growth raises downside risk for global cyclicals, EM-exposed equities and commodities-linked stocks, partially offsetting US-driven positivity.

Equities.title: U.S. strikes Iranian missile sites, defense systems and reinstates port blockade
Equities.summary: President Donald Trump has said the U.S.-Iran ceasefire is over following multiple flare-ups of hostilities in the region.
Equities.reason: Geopolitical shock increases near-term risk aversion and oil-price uncertainty; likely to pressure risk assets and raise volatility despite otherwise constructive macro data.

Equities.title: IBM stock craters 25%, the worst day on record, after company issues second-quarter earnings warning
Equities.summary: The CEO blamed the shortfall on weakness in the software and infrastructure business because clients shifted money toward hardware purchases.
Equities.reason: Notable large-cap tech shock that can weigh on tech sentiment and multiple compression; signals potential reallocation within tech (hardware vs. software) and caution around enterprise spending.

Equities.title: PayPal jumps 15% in premarket trading on reports Stripe, Advent are weighing $53 billion takeover
Equities.summary: Stripe and Advent International have reportedly made a joint offer to acquire PayPal Holdings Inc for $60.50 per share, in a deal that would value the payments company at more than $53 billion.
Equities.reason: Large-cap M&A bid lifting a major payments name is a constructive idiosyncratic and M&A-flow signal that supports risk appetite and can buoy fintech/transaction-related stocks.

Equities.title: SK Hynix shares jump nearly 13%, tracking US stock gains
Equities.reason: Asia tech/semiconductor rebound that tracks the US chip narrative; reinforces the cross-market recovery in semiconductors driven by AI demand and softer macro prints.

Rates.title: Australian Dollar strengthens to near 0.7000 as soft US CPI tempers Fed tightening bets
Rates.summary: The AUD/USD pair gathers strength to around 0.6990 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) as markets reduced their bets of a US rate hike after US inflation slowed more than expecte
Rates.reason: Article links a softer US CPI to reduced Fed-hike bets and USD weakness — transmission that typically implies lower US yields / bond rally. Medium-low relevance (FX piece with explicit rates transmission).

Rates.title: U.S. June CPI fell 0.4%, likely cooling move toward Fed rate hikes
Rates.reason: Headline CPI miss is a major rates catalyst — sharply reduces near‑term Fed hike probability and is strongly supportive of bond prices (yields down). High relevance as primary macro data driver for rates markets.

Rates.title: Bond Traders Ditch July Rate-Hike Bets on Surprise Inflation Dip
Rates.reason: Market reaction piece showing traders repricing out imminent Fed hikes — direct evidence of bond-market positioning shifting toward a rally (yields lower). High relevance as it documents market flows and expectations.

Rates.title: Stocks, Bonds Rise as Soft CPI Curbs Fed-Hike Bets: Markets Wrap
Rates.reason: Synthesis of market moves showing both equity and bond reactions to softer CPI — supports the narrative of Fed-hike odds falling and a bond rally. Broad market wrap gives it above-average relevance.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Support pillar weakens after CPI – MUFG
Rates.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny notes that weaker US CPI has sharply reduced market expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike, undermining a key source of recent US Dollar strength.
Rates.reason: Analysis explicitly ties weaker CPI to reduced Fed-hike expectations and USD pressure — implies downward pressure on US yields. Relevant commentary from a major bank, modestly weighted.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Long positioning faces reality check – DBS
Rates.summary: DBS Group Research economist Philip Wee warns that speculative long positions in the US Dollar (USD) look vulnerable after June US CPI surprised on the downside.
Rates.reason: Highlights speculative positioning adjustments after the CPI surprise — supports the bond-market narrative (lower yields) but is primarily positioning commentary so assigned lower relevance.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: Inflation scenarios guide rate path – ABN AMRO
Rates.summary: ABN AMRO’s Rogier Quaedvlieg reviews the latest United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) downside surprise and its implications for the Federal Reserve (Fed).
Rates.reason: Research note connecting the CPI downside surprise to Fed rate-path scenarios — implies a bias toward lower yields if inflation proves softer. Useful policy-context commentary with moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Oil surges, stocks slip and bond yields rise as Gulf conflict flares up again
Rates.reason: Geopolitical risk pushing oil higher and yields up — acts as a countervailing force against the CPI-driven bond rally. Relevant because it directly reports rising bond yields due to risk premium.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026
Rates.reason: Official FOMC minutes are a direct input to market expectations for the policy path — in the current context they are likely to reinforce how the Fed views inflation momentum, so moderate relevance to rates positioning.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar edges higher ahead of BoC rate decision
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair loses traction to near 1.4050 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. Traders expect the US Federal Reserve (Fed) to skip the July rate hike as inflation cools, weighing on the US Dollar (USD) against the Canadian Dollar (CAD).
FX.reason: USD weakness theme: market pricing out a July Fed hike, supportive for CAD vs USD (USD/CAD lower). Relevant near-term ahead of BoC and tied to Fed expectations.

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar retreats after soft inflation data, focus shifts to BoC rate decision
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Wednesday, July 15:
FX.reason: Broad, market-moving USD narrative: soft US inflation weakens USD and shifts attention to central-bank timing (Fed/BoC). High relevance because this is a cross-market macro driver for FX.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Remains below 101.00 near ascending channel bottom
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is extending its losses for the second successive day, trading around 100.80 during the early European hours on Wednesday.
FX.reason: DXY technical/price-forecast: shows USD losing ground. Treated as lower-relevance technical signal (price-forecast rule) supporting broader USD weakness.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Reflects volatility contraction amid triangle formation
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair trades slightly lower at around 162.20 during the European trading session on Wednesday. The pair edges down as the US Dollar (USD) underperforms due to easing fears of interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve (Fed) this year.
FX.reason: Pair-specific technical note: USD underperformance vs JPY as Fed-hike fears ease. Price-forecast items get capped relevance but reinforce the USD-soft narrative.

FX.title: Euro picks up favoured by a weaker US Dollar but remains within previous ranges
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) extends gains for the second consecutive day against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, but remains trapped within the trading range seen over the last three weeks, with upside attempts capped below the 1.1470-1.1480 area so far.
FX.reason: EUR strength tied directly to weaker USD/DXY. Relevant as it reflects cross-market USD retreat and supports EURUSD moves, though range-bound context tempers relevance.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: Upside momentum building toward 0.7015 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD surged to 0.6992 after an earlier dip, with strong short-term momentum pointing to further gains. They see scope for a test of 0.6995, while the major resistance at 0.7015 is key.
FX.reason: AUD/USD technical call: short-term momentum on AUD consistent with USD weakness. Treated as price-forecast with capped relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee gains support as traders dial down hawkish Fed bets
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) gains ground against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after rising significantly in the last three trading days.
FX.reason: EMFX move linked to a softer USD as markets trim Fed-hike odds. Relevant as an emerging-market response to the broader USD direction.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar: RBNZ hawkish tone supports gains – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) continues to outperform G10 peers, underpinned by hawkish Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) rhetoric and improving domestic activity data.
FX.reason: NZD-specific fundamental driver (RBNZ hawkishness) supporting NZD vs USD; contributes to USD-soft multi-G10 narrative but is also idiosyncratic, so moderate relevance.

FX.title: PBoC’s Deputy Governor: To continue to implement appropriately loose monetary policy
FX.summary: People’s Bank of China (PBoC) Deputy Governor said during the European trading session on Wednesday that the central bank remains committed to loose monetary policy conditions to support overall demand.
FX.reason: PBoC easing bias tends to pressure CNY and be USD-supportive (USD strength vs CNY). Counted as a regional central-bank signal that offsets some of the USD-weak momentum; moderate relevance.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Appreciation scope seen limited against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank highlights that China’s weak domestic economy and reliance on exports constrain upside for the Chinese Yuan. Despite solid export growth and sizeable trade surpluses, investment and real retail sales remain soft.
FX.reason: Macro/FX research flagging limited CNY upside versus USD (implies USD relative strength vs CNY). Regional FX view with moderate relevance to USD-basket.

FX.title: Japanese Retail Traders Boost Dollar Shorts to Most Since 2008
FX.reason: Positioning signal from Japan: retail traders increasing dollar shorts suggests local market bets on USD weakness (JPY-related positioning). Useful as a sentiment/positioning input.

FX.title: What Is the Carry Trade That’s Weakening the Yen?
FX.reason: Carry-trade flows are a structural force weakening JPY (supporting USD/JPY and other USD/JPY crosses). This is a meaningful countervailing force to the USD-soft headlines and has market-flow relevance.

FX.title: Dollar edges higher on escalating US-Iran tension, yen slides on pension doubts
FX.reason: Geopolitical risk (US-Iran) lifting USD as safe-haven and pressuring risk-linked currencies; important cross-market driver that supports USD strength and offsets soft-US data narrative.

FX.title: GBP/JPY remains close to multi-year peak as UK-Japan rate gap and Iran risks undermine JPY
FX.summary: The GBP/JPY cross scales higher for the second straight day and climbs to a fresh weekly top, around the 217.70 region, during the first half of the European session on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Cross-rate shows JPY weakness driven by UK-Japan rate gap and Iran tensions — a JPY-centric flow that typically lifts USD/JPY as well. Included as a JPY-specific macro-flow signal.

Commodities.title: Oil prices rise 2% as hostilities worsen in the Middle East
Commodities.reason: Major geopolitical escalation (U.S.-Iran strikes, worsening hostilities) is a clear supply-risk shock to oil markets; strong bullish impulse and high market relevance for crude prices and energy risk premia.

Commodities.title: Brent: Stable prices follow short squeeze – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank strategist Michael Every notes Brent Oil holding steady around $85-86 per barrel after an aggressive short squeeze. Every links this stability to ongoing Middle East tensions, United States (US) sanctions enforcement in Hormuz, and strategic efforts t
Commodities.reason: Analyst note confirms the dominant narrative: Middle East tensions and short-covering underpin Brent stability/rally. Relevant market commentary reinforcing oil upside.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Consolidates around $79.00, above 200-day EMA and 23.6% Fibo.
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – oscillates in a narrow band during the Asian session on Wednesday, consolidating its weekly gains to a nearly one-month peak set the previous day.
Commodities.reason: Technical consolidation above key moving averages supports a mildly bullish near-term oil bias; treated as lower-relevance technical signal (price-forecast piece).

Commodities.title: The United States produced more crude oil than any other country in 2025
Commodities.summary: The United States remained the world's largest crude oil producer in 2025, according to our International Energy Statistics database, extending a streak that began in 2018 when the United States overtook Russia to become the world's leading producer.
Commodities.reason: Higher U.S. production implies a structurally large supply base that can cap upside in global oil prices; meaningful but not immediate shock to prices (supply-side headwind).

Commodities.title: U.S. exports of crude oil and petroleum products reached record in April
Commodities.summary: U.S. petroleum exports reached a record in April as disruptions to international crude oil and refined product flows through the Strait of Hormuz increased global demand for U.S. exports. Exports increased to 13.6 million barrels per day (b/d) in April, 15% mo
Commodities.reason: Record U.S. exports reflect both strong external demand and re-routing related to Strait of Hormuz disruptions — supportive for global tightness in the near term, but also a signal of shifting flows rather than pure supply growth.

Commodities.title: Gold slips as oil rally keeps inflation, rate outlook on investors' radar
Commodities.reason: Rising oil and renewed inflation/higher-for-longer rate expectations are a headwind for gold (opportunity cost of holding non-yielding metal); market-moving macro linkage for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Gold: Rebound needs softer Oil and data – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong report that Gold has rebounded from sub-4000 levels after softer United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) prompted markets to pare Fed hike expectations and pushed USD and front-end US Treasury yields lower.
Commodities.reason: Bank commentary highlights that gold upside is contingent on softer oil and inflation data; current oil-driven inflation risk keeps gold vulnerable — concise fundamental view with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD holds below $59.00 despite US Dollar’s weakness
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) ticks lower on Wednesday, trading at $58.50 at the time of writing, after rejection at the $59.00 area on Tuesday. The sour market sentiment amid rising hostilities in Iran continues to weigh on the precious metal, offsetting the positive impa
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece showing silver under pressure from risk sentiment and geopolitical uncertainty despite USD softness; treated as lower-relevance technical signal for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Global liquefied natural gas trade volumes reached record high in 2025
Commodities.summary: Global liquefied natural gas (LNG) trade volumes increased 5.4% to a record 56.3 billion cubic feet per day last year (Bcf/d), driven largely by U.S. LNG export capacity expanding to meet growing demand, according to a recent report from the International Grou
Commodities.reason: Record LNG trade volumes and expanding U.S. export capacity support stronger global gas markets and underline structural demand growth; moderately bullish for natural gas prices and related markets.

Commodities.title: Corn Fades into Monday’s Close, as Crop Ratings Improve
Commodities.reason: Improving crop ratings signal a better-than-expected supply outlook for corn, a direct bearish fundamental for corn prices; treated as a regional agricultural supply-side negative.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin rises past $64,000 after soft inflation data, Warsh testimony
Crypto.reason: Macro shock (softer inflation) driving risk-on flows into Bitcoin; direct price reaction suggests positive liquidity/demand impulse for crypto.

Crypto.title: U.S.-Iran escalation weighs on bitcoin, stocks as oil climbs
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical risk and commodity-driven risk-off flows hurting risk assets including crypto; likely to dampen demand and increase volatility.

Crypto.title: Binance bets on becoming a crypto 'super app' as stablecoins reshape growth
Crypto.reason: Major exchange expanding into broader payments/financial services and leaning on stablecoin-led growth; supportive for ecosystem adoption and fee/liquidity growth.

Crypto.title: Visa, Mastercard and Ripple back x402 as agent payments average 32 cents
Crypto.reason: Major global card networks endorsing a stablecoin payments standard is a material adoption milestone — large merchant reach and payments utility materially boost crypto use-cases.

Crypto.title: U.S., UK move to align rules for tokenized finance across world's largest financial markets
Crypto.reason: Regulatory alignment between major jurisdictions reduces fragmentation and legal uncertainty around tokenized assets — a pro-institutional-adoption development for crypto.

Crypto.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid's rise threatens Circle's USDC economics
Crypto.reason: Competitive pressure in the stablecoin market could strain USDC economics and market structure; negative for issuer concentration but not systemic to crypto demand overall.

Crypto.title: Ethereum Foundation spinout EthSystems targets banks with blockchain privacy technology
Crypto.reason: Infrastructure and privacy tech targeting banks signals incremental institutional integration and use-cases for blockchains in regulated finance.

Crypto.title: For pension funds, tokenization’s real play is balance-sheet management, Fidelity’s Lai says
Crypto.reason: Institutional demand theme: pension funds exploring tokenization for balance-sheet efficiency supports a credible long-term institutional adoption narrative.

Crypto.title: Japan’s biggest card network taps Circle to bring stablecoins to 40 million merchants
Crypto.reason: Large-scale merchant reach via a major card network for stablecoins is a substantial adoption catalyst with direct transactional demand implications for stablecoin rails and broader crypto usage.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin’s great rotation: Long-term holders pass supply to a new generation of buyers
Crypto.reason: On-chain supply dynamics showing distribution to newer buyers supports demand and liquidity; constructive signal for medium-term price foundation.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin steadies at $62,600 as South Koreans flee stocks rout for crypto
Crypto.reason: Regional flow into crypto from equity-market stress (South Korea) indicates demand-side resilience and cross-asset hedging/flow dynamics supportive of prices.

Crypto.title: XRP and ether bulls are getting louder as prices fall, signaling more trouble ahead
Crypto.reason: Altcoin-specific deterioration and bullish sentiment divergence suggests localized downside risk for XRP/ETH market segments; modest negative for altcoin risk profile.

Crypto.title: U.S. government moves $288 million in seized bitcoin, ether to Coinbase Prime
Crypto.reason: Movement of seized crypto into an exchange/custodian could raise sell-pressure or heightened regulatory scrutiny; small-to-moderate negative liquidity signal.

Crypto.title: Prediction markets just crushed traditional sportsbooks in a massive $50 billion World Cup breakout
Crypto.reason: Large-scale growth in crypto-native prediction markets versus traditional sportsbooks signals user adoption and real-world product-market fit in a niche sector.

Crypto.title: Some U.S. Senate Democrats come out against Clarity Act, calling it a 'corrupt' bill
Crypto.reason: Political opposition and controversy around a major crypto-related bill increases legislative uncertainty and could delay or complicate policy clarity beneficial to the sector.
